fields.statement: At c3aa860: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/inbox-stale passes. The script builds fixture change sets and journals: a failed run and a gave-up run each on landed, withdrawn, rejected and superseded change sets (a dumped rhiza change ls --json showed all eight in those states, superseded included), one of each on an accepted change set, a failed run on unknown change set CSUNKNOWN, and a question and a sign-off on a landed change set. rhiza inbox and inbox --json list exactly F-ACCEPTED, G-ACCEPTED, F-UNKNOWN, Q-LANDED and S-LANDED (5 kinds in --json), with none of the eight stale runs. Mutation probe in a scratch worktree: removing the gone() check on ended failed runs makes the script fail (F-WITHDRAWN listed), and removing it on the gave-up branch alone also makes it fail. The diff applies goneChanges (State.Terminal: landed, rejected, withdrawn, superseded; an unknown change or unreadable log counts as not gone) to inbox, inbox open and daemon notify. make fmt-check, vet and go test ./... pass; make self-check fails only on stale rendered actor files for this run's sessions, not on this leaf's code.
